attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Kentucky military retirement exemption (2025). Flat $31,110 exemption (matches general pension exclusion). SBP payments receive same treatment. Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, KY DOR.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize KY military retirement exemption calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "KY Military Retirement Exemption Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ky_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.ky_military_retirement_taxable xdef

action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay result.ky_military_retirement_exemption_amount min /result.ky_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.ky_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.ky_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"KY military retirement exemption: $" result.ky_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.ky_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.ky_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.ky_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No KY military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Kentucky state income tax calculation. Implements flat 4% tax structure with $3,270 standard deduction per KY tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Kentucky Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate KY flat tax (4% rate, $3,270 standard deduction)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ky_standard_deduction sub 0 max
dup /result.ky_taxable_income xdef
result.ky_tax_rate mul
dup /result.ky_state_tax xdef
/result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Kentucky tax calculated: AGI=$" result.agi cvs strconcat " Deduction=$" strconcat result.ky_standard_deduction cvs strconcat " Taxable=$" strconcat result.ky_taxable_income cvs strconcat " Tax=$" strconcat result.ky_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
